sim_label: physics lap sim · quasi-steady-state point mass · hungaroring field-median telemetry line · car calibrated to 2026 British GP qualifying, set-up and track grip fitted to 2026 Hungarian GP qualifying

trained.doe: Latin hypercubes, seeded: 2400 over centre ± 100 % of the box, 1800 over centre ± 50 % of the box, 1800 over centre ± 20 % of the box

raw.source: the sim's 11 fitted team cars (teamCars()) and the centre car + MARGIN

centre_car.label: Red Bull Racing (inferred from public 2026 British GP qualifying lap + speed trap, not team data; telemetry-derived overrides from concept/data/redbull-2026*.json); hungaroring set-up: wing -1.723 deg (multi-track fit)

error_vs_distance.definition: distance = max over RAW fields of |x − centre| / (box half-width on that side); test split, chosen models

ranking.definition: 40 parents (random walks from the concept baseline) × 8 children (design.mutate σ 0.08); Δlap = child − parent; designs carried relative to the concept baseline onto the centre car

machine.note: wall-clock numbers of the training machine; not deterministic
